# sgtlearn

> Python estimators for Shape Generalized Trees and forests with a scikit-learn API.

## Start here

- [For AI coding agents](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agents.html): Fit, tune, and inspect an SGT using supported APIs.
- [Installation](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html): Install the package or build from source.
- [Quick Start](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/quickstart.html): Train and plot a tree.

## Reference and tutorials

- [API Reference](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/index.html): Estimators, TAO, plotting, exports, and datasets.
- [Shape functions tutorial](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/shape-functions.html): See how SGT nodes learn and visualize nonlinear splits.
- [Forests tutorial](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/forests.html): Compare a single tree, an SG forest, and a CART forest.
- [Categorical features](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/categorical-features.html): Group one-hot columns into logical features.
- [Hyperparameter tuning](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorials/hyperparameter-tuning.html): Search with scikit-learn and Optuna.
- [Roadmap](https://sgtlearn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/roadmap.html): Implemented and planned features.
